name: Links Connect
description: Links Connect gives finance teams a single source of truth — bridging operational and financial systems so live business data flows directly to Claude. Connect the tools you already rely on, and let Claude handle the analysis, reporting, and workflows automatically, without disrupting what's already in place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Links Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Links Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.thelinks.ai/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Links Connect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Links Connect provides these MCP tools: links__mcp__get_hubspot_contact, links__mcp__get_hubspot_company, links__mcp__get_hubspot_deal, links__mcp__get_hubspot_product, links__mcp__get_stripe_customer, links__mcp__get_stripe_product, links__mcp__get_stripe_invoice, and links__mcp__get_insurance_policy.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Links Connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Links Connect in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.

_published_faq.name: Does Links Connect MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Links Connect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Links Connect is developed by Links Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
